usual_baseline: Indication and maximum 24-hour dose are near 100% [3316][3498][3612]. Review is the gap: review date 0/32 [3612], ward round review 3.2% [3498], reviewed in last 7 days 25% [3316]. Unused PRN not stopped: 0% [3498], 0/8 [3612], 5 of 21 still active [3640]. PRN protocol standards met in 53% [3072].
fix_that_works: Induction teaching, weekly pharmacist discussion, chart prompts and weekly MDT PRN review: reviewed in last 7 days 25% to 56% [3316]. After a serious incident, ward round reviews rose from 3.2% to 64.5% and minimum dose interval from 64.5% to 93.5% [3498].
fix_that_fails: Stopping unused PRN only reached 22.2% and review of regularly used PRN 28.5% [3498]. Minimum dose documented rose only from 10.7% to 24%, and no item reached the 100% standard [3316].
consultant_advice: Don't audit indication or maximum dose; they are nearly always met. Audit review and discontinuation. One Trust added an automatic 14-day review date in EPMA [3612]; re-auditing whether that works would be more useful than a new baseline.
